positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Contributor to React-based web application that provided real-time status and management of students’ transportation.
Technologies used:
  * React
  * Material UI
  * Vite
  * Azure Cloud Services
  * Orkes Workflow Orchestration

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Modernized front-end stack with TypeScript, Preact, and Storybook, improving performance, maintainability, and user experience of dynamic UI components.

- Optimized build system by integrating Yarn, Turborepo, Rollup, and Webpack, achieving faster builds, reduced deployment errors, and improved developer productivity.

- Spearheaded test automation with Selenium, Playwright, Karma, Mocha, and Testing Library, reducing test failures to less than 0.01% and ensuring continuous product quality.

- Automated continuous testing and delivery pipelines (CI/CD), enhancing product quality, release speed, and system reliability.
Mentored junior engineers and established coding best practices, strengthening team effectiveness.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Reengineered front-end architecture from monolithic to modular using JBoss, XML, and ExtJS, improving scalability, maintainability, and feature velocity.

- Standardized testing libraries across teams, increasing product reliability and customer satisfaction.

- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align UI modernization efforts with enterprise system goals, accelerating delivery of new features.

- Introduced Agile and test-driven development practices, reducing defect rates and improving release predictability.
